title: Complex Bandpass Decimator
text: Extract a frequency subband using a one-sided (complex) bandpass decimator, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Filter specification} sets Filter design parameters Decimation; {Decimation factor}, {Bandwidth} sets the width of frequency band of interest, {Specify center frequency from input port} sets the source of center frequency, {Center frequency}, {Stopband attenuation (dB)} sets the stopband attenuation in dB, {Passband ripple (dB)} sets the passband ripple in dB, {Transition width}, {Reduce number of complex coefficients} sets the minimize number of complex coefficients, {Mix signal to baseband}, {Sample rate mode} sets the mode to specify the input sample rate Use normalized, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the input sample rate in Hz, {Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals}, {View Filter Response} sets the visualize frequency response, {View Info} sets the view filter information and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Filter specification
params.values: Filter design parameters Decimation factor (default) | Bandwidth | Decimation factor and bandwidth

params.name: Bandwidth
params.values: Width of frequency band of interest 0.2268 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Specify center frequency from input port
params.values: Specify source of center frequency off (default) | on

params.name: Center frequency
params.values: Center frequency of desired band 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Stopband attenuation (dB)
params.values: Stopband attenuation in dB 80 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Passband ripple (dB)
params.values: Passband ripple in dB 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Reduce number of complex coefficients
params.values: Minimize number of complex coefficients on (default) | off

params.name: Mix signal to baseband
params.values: Mix signal to baseband on (default) | off

params.name: Sample rate mode
params.values: Mode to specify the input sample rate Use normalized frequency (0 to 1) (default) | Specify on dialog | Inherit from input port

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Input sample rate in Hz 44100 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals
params.values: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
